english:
Find Match lets you join constructed queues: Ranked, Play, and Brawl!

• Ranked puts your skills to the test in four constructed formats: Standard, Alchemy, Historic, and Pioneer. Matches in this queue will affect your seasonal ranking. You can toggle to choose to play in Best of One, where you play a single game, or Best of Three, where games include sideboarding, and the first player to win two games wins the match.

• Play lets you play the same four formats, but these do not impact your constructed rank. You can still choose Best of One or Best of Three, and you can even play against Sparky in a Bot Match!

• Brawl is where you play the casual singleton formats (where only one copy of each card is allowed in your deck) of Brawl and Standard Brawl! Choose your Commander to build around and battle!
chinese:
寻找对局则让你可以投身构筑赛制对战，有天梯、对战和争锋三种模式可供选择！

• 天梯中提供了四种构筑赛制，你可以任选其一来挑战技艺：标准、炼金、史迹和先驱。你在此队列中的对局结果将会影响你的赛季段位。你可以在单盘制（只进行一盘对局）或三盘制（包含备牌，先夺取两盘对战胜利的牌手便赢下整局对战）。

• 对战同样提供了这四种赛制的对战队列，但对局结果不会影响你的构筑段位。你也可以在此选择单盘制或三盘制，甚至还能在人机对战中跟辉辉切磋！

• 争锋则是进行休闲无双对战（每种只能加入一张）的好去处，有争锋和标准争锋供你选择！因此快快来选择一位指挥官，然后投身对战！

english: Compete for monetary rewards! Players must join the Day 2 event between 6 a.m. PT - 8 a.m. PT (1400 UTC - 1600 UTC). This second day of competition is open only to qualified players from Day 1. The Day 2 format is Traditional Alchemy with best-of-three matches using sideboards and individual timers. Players may only enter once, even if they have qualified multiple times. For assistance, click here to contact Customer Service. Must be 18 years or older to participate. Not available in all regions/territories. Void where prohibited. Receiving monetary rewards requires creating or having existing Wizards, DCI, and i-Payout accounts. See here for full details.
chinese: 参加赛事，竞夺奖金！ 牌手必须在6 a.m. PT - 8 a.m. PT（1400 UTC - 1600 UTC）之间加入第2天赛事。 此「第2天」赛事仅向经由「第1天」赛事获得参赛资格的牌手开放。 第2天的赛制为三盘两胜制（可更换备牌且牌手个别计时）的传统调谐赛。就算牌手多次经第1天赢得资格，也只能参加一次第2天赛事。若需协助，请点按此处联系客户支持。 须年满18周岁方能参加。部分地区／地域不能参加本赛事。在法律禁止的地区无效。须创建或具现有威世智、DCI及i-Payout帐户方能领取奖金。完整详细信息，请参阅此处。
